text:

text: I've been treated at Rajavithi Nakornping Hospital every time. Every time I've been treated, the staff have been friendly and helpful. The doctors are skilled and thorough. I'm very impressed. restaurant_name: Rajavithi Nakornping Hospital in Chiang Mai
text:
Today was my first time using the service here. I have to say that I was very impressed. From the screening point, the staff were very polite, cheerful, and provided detailed information about my symptoms and were very willing to provide service. The doctors were excellent, asking about my symptoms and discussing the treatment until I understood.
Every step of the service process was excellent, with the steps organized well and quickly.
The only thing that could be improved is the location. It might be small and cramped, and the screening point is an open-air area with no air conditioning. It can get a bit hot, but that's okay, as it's a government office, so it might not be convenient to renovate. But if it's improved, it will be excellent. Thank you, God, and thank you to everyone here.

restaurant_name: Rajavithi Nakornping Hospital in Chiang Mai
text:
Thank you to the registration staff, nurses, and doctors at Nakornping Hospital, Sridonchai Branch, on December 28, 2022.
I suddenly remembered that I had to pick up my mother's bronchial inhaler today, around 3:30 PM. The thought flashed through my mind:
"I forgot to pick up my mother's medication!!!" Immediately, I picked up the phone and called Nakornping Hospital, Sridonchai Branch. The cheerful voice on the other end urged me to hurry before 3:45 PM. "Um... I'd like to leave my grandmother's name for you..." I was very impressed when I arrived. The registration staff saw the doctor and requested the medication on my behalf. I was able to request permission to see the doctor, and the doctor kindly prescribed a 3-month supply of medication in advance. I am deeply grateful to the registration staff for their service-mindedness. Thank you very much.
Dr. Krisana Kaephuek
Specialized Public Health Academic
Chiang Mai Public Health Center 1
P.S.
I had many tasks today: adjusting the Health Region 1 project, group meetings, coordinating with the province, etc.

restaurant_name: Rajavithi Nakornping Hospital in Chiang Mai
text:
There is a hospital with the same name to the north. If you are coming for a COVID-19 test, you can come here. The test costs 200 baht, and they even issue a certificate!

If you come by taxi, you can find it by heading to the parking lot behind the building.

In my case, I went around 10:30 AM and there was no one there. So I registered right away, and when I told them my home test result was positive, they asked me a few questions and started the test. I got the impression that they conduct the testing strictly, separating the areas for sample collection and testing just like public health centers in Korea.

After the diagnosis, they prescribed medication. They gave me a large handful of pills, so I was worried about the cost, but I was so grateful to hear that it was free! The medicine was effective, and my slightly sore throat went away in just one day.

It is a really friendly hospital, so please visit for a COVID-19 test!
